source.title: Firefighting
source.description: You there, you've just been conscripted! The fire elementals just won't stop pouring out of the Cauldron. I need you to get in there and cauterize the wound, if you take my meaning. Snap to it, soldier!
source.objective: Overseer Oilfist wants you to slay 15 Firelands Invaders in The Cauldron, south of Thorium Point.
source.completion: Well done, <name>. You got some grit, I'll give you that.
